For example, if you wanted to send a unique message based on the customer’s region, language preference, or gender. Oftentimes your rules are a combination of multiple attributes in addition to customer behavior events and context data. Reusable Rules saves you significant time as you can create these rules once and then reuse them across campaigns with the ability to quickly modify them inline at the time of authoring.
